body.message: Hello Lyak, At the moment, we do not have any 3-bedroom apartments with a maid's room available. However, if a standard 3-bedroom apartment would be suitable for you, we have one available from tomorrow,  14th August , at  Imperial Avenue, Downtown Dubai . If this option works for you, please let us know, and we will be happy to share the payment details and assist you further. Thank you. Chahana T. fäm Living
